boundary.implementationTarget: A future approved worktree created from the maintained upstream application repository.

findings.remediation: Upgrade the owning dependency chains to versions that resolve brace-expansion above the audited vulnerable ranges; do not add an override without compatibility evidence.

Refresh the audit in the future upstream task, select the then-current patched Next.js release compatible with OpenNext, and verify App Router, Server Actions, rewrites, image handling, and middleware-to-proxy behavior.
Resolve to a patched version above 8.5.17 through compatible parent upgrades or a reviewed override, then prove source-map handling and builds.
Resolve to sharp 0.35.0 or newer through compatible Next.js and Cloudflare tooling updates, then verify image processing and Worker builds on the supported runtime.

Plan an explicit Astro 7 migration rather than using npm audit fix --force; the audit identifies 7.1.3 as the first proposed fix target, which must be refreshed and migration-tested at execution time.
Resolve outside the vulnerable 0.27.3 through 0.28.0 range through the Astro toolchain upgrade and verify Windows development-server isolation.
Refresh the transitive graph to a release above 3.1.3 and exercise URL and host validation paths.
Resolve above 4.2.0 through parent upgrades and test content/config parsing with bounded fixtures.
Resolve above 8.5.17 through the Astro toolchain upgrade and verify CSS and source-map output.
Resolve to sharp 0.35.0 or newer through the Astro major upgrade and verify image output across supported formats.
Resolve above 4.0.1 and add an executable-script SVG regression fixture before accepting optimized SVG output.

actions: Create approved implementation packets and isolated worktrees against the maintained upstream application, never this compatibility snapshot.
Refresh both production-dependency audits and map each advisory to reachable runtime features before changing manifests.
Prioritize public request handling, Server Actions, rewrites, images, Astro rendering, and SVG optimization; document any non-reachability claim as expiring risk evidence.
exitCriteria: Fresh machine-readable audit evidence is attached to each implementation packet.
Every high-severity advisory has an owner, disposition, and validation mapping.
No production, staging, payment, inventory, booking, database, or credential action is included.

remediationWaves.owner: codex-engineering-executor with security and Cloudflare review
actions: Upgrade Next.js and compatible OpenNext/Cloudflare packages to versions that clear the refreshed advisories.
Refresh package-lock.json atomically with package.json; do not use an unreviewed force fix.
Add focused tests for Server Action limits, rewrite destination validation, response caching, image SVG handling, internal function disclosure, and proxy behavior.
exitCriteria: The root production-dependency audit exits zero with no high or critical findings.
Root lint, typecheck, unit tests, application build, Cloudflare dry-run build, and scoped regression tests pass.
Security and Cloudflare reviewers approve compatibility evidence; no protected operational domain changed.

actions: Migrate Astro to a refreshed patched major release using its official migration guidance; treat the audit-proposed 7.1.3 target as provisional until execution.
Refresh the storefront lockfile and transitive esbuild, fast-uri, js-yaml, postcss, sharp, and svgo resolutions without blind force fixing.
Add regression fixtures for script termination, spread attributes, slot names, transition directives, server-island replay, host handling, SVG scripts, YAML resource bounds, and image generation.
exitCriteria: The storefront production-dependency audit exits zero with no high or critical findings.
Astro check, static build, metadata/freeze verification, and security regression fixtures pass.
Rendered Thai and English routes and booking handoff URLs remain compatible.

actions: Independently inspect manifest and lockfile diffs, advisory closure, scope, secret boundaries, and generated artifacts.
Exercise local builds and test suites in clean disposable environments.
Prepare a pull request with rollback notes; request staging or production actions only through separately approved release tasks.
exitCriteria: Independent verification passes and records evidence.
The pull request contains no snapshot, architecture-source, migration, payment, inventory, or credential changes.
Production eligibility remains false until a distinct authorized release workflow approves it.

releaseGates.passCondition: Command exits zero and reports zero critical and zero high production-dependency vulnerabilities; any exception is separately approved, expiring, and linked as evidence.

releaseGates.scope: Future maintained upstream root application task
releaseGates.passCondition: All approved local checks exit zero in a clean environment and focused security regressions pass.

releaseGates.scope: Future maintained upstream Astro storefront task
releaseGates.passCondition: All approved local checks exit zero and security, rendered-route, metadata, and booking-handoff fixtures pass.
An independent reviewer confirms scope, audit closure, deterministic checks, rollback, and forbidden-path compliance.

requiredFields: advisory identifiers and affected dependency paths
named approving owner and independent security reviewer

rollback.strategy: Revert the future upstream remediation commit or pull request as one unit if verification regresses; restore the manifest and lockfile together, and rerun the prior known-good local checks before any separately authorized release action.
